attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, it does 120 more damage.

abilities.name: Exciting Stage
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand instead. You can't use more than 1 Exciting Stage Ability each turn.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Max Blaze
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 of your Benched Rapid Strike Pokémon and attach an Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.

attacks.name: Cross Fist
attacks.text: If 1 of your other Rapid Strike Pokémon used an attack during your last turn, this attack also does 160 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Sky Hurricane
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sky Hurricane.

abilities.name: Lustrous Body
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: G-Max Hurricane
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use G-Max Hurricane.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, it recovers from all Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Blissful Blast
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you did any damage with this attack, you may attach up to 3 Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Friends in Galar
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Gordie
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Professor Burnet
cards.text: Look through your deck for up to 2 cards and discard them. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Sordward & Shielbert
cards.text: Choose a Trainer card from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put it into your hand. If yes, put that card into your hand. If no, draw 3 cards.
